if (!defined('ABSPATH')) { exit; }
add_action('after_setup_theme', function () {
    add_theme_support('title-tag');

});
add_action('wp_enqueue_scripts', function () {
    if (!is_page('black-friday-2026') && !is_front_page()) { return; }
    $dir = get_stylesheet_directory();
    $url = get_stylesheet_directory_uri();
    wp_enqueue_style('dt-bf26-preview-shell', $url . '/style.css', array(), (string) filemtime($dir . '/style.css'));
    wp_enqueue_style('dt-bf26-css', $url . '/datatour-bf26.css', array('dt-bf26-preview-shell'), (string) filemtime($dir . '/datatour-bf26.css'));
    wp_enqueue_script('dt-bf26-js', $url . '/datatour-bf26.js', array(), (string) filemtime($dir . '/datatour-bf26.js'), true);
});

<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$admin = get_user_by('login', 'admin');
if (!$admin || !user_can($admin, 'unfiltered_html')) { throw new RuntimeException('An administrator with unfiltered_html is required for this demo page.'); }
wp_set_current_user($admin->ID);
$html = file_get_contents('/wordpress/wp-content/themes/datatour-bf26/datatour-bf26.html');
if (!$html || strpos($html, 'id="dt-bf26"') === false) { throw new RuntimeException('Datatour HTML is missing or invalid.'); }
$existing = get_page_by_path('black-friday-2026', OBJECT, 'page');
$post = array('post_type'=>'page', 'post_title'=>'Чёрная пятница 2026 — Datatour', 'post_name'=>'black-friday-2026', 'post_status'=>'publish', 'post_content'=>wp_slash('<!-- wp:html -->' . "\n" . $html . "\n" . '<!-- /wp:html -->'), 'comment_status'=>'closed', 'ping_status'=>'closed');
if ($existing) { $post['ID'] = $existing->ID; }
$id = wp_insert_post($post, true);
if (is_wp_error($id)) { throw new RuntimeException($id->get_error_message()); }
echo 'Datatour page ready: ' . $id;
